One of the [[War in Kryta]] quests, the objective of this quest is to kill the [[White Mantle]] boss [[Inquisitor Lashona]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
Must have access to [[Lion's Arch Keep]], see [[:File:War in Kryta flow chart.png|flowchart]] for details.

===Objectives===
* Kill [[Inquisitor Lashona]] in [[North Kryta Province (War in Kryta)|North Kryta Province]]
* *BONUS* Kill Inquisitor Lashona in [[Hard Mode]]
* See [[Princess Salma]] for your reward

===Reward===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1000 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[War Supplies]]
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 10 War Supplies

==Walkthrough==
Follow the road from [[Lion's Arch]] to the [[Ascalon Settlement]]. Inquisitor Lashona is found talking to [[Captain Greywind]]. Once he is dead, you can [[map travel|map out]] or [[resign]], as killing his minions is not part of the quest.

It is also possible (and easier) to travel from [[Bergen Hot Springs]].

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Wanted by the Shining Blade
:''"[[Inquisitor Lashona]] is wanted for crimes against the Krytan people and the flagrant abuse of his authority. Lashona was last seen in [[North Kryta Province]]. Eliminate this menace and claim your bounty from Queen Salma."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll do whatever I can to help restore order to Kryta.
| decline = War! What is it good for?
| ask = Justice must be done! Go kill [[Inquisitor Lashona]] in [[North Kryta Province]].
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
:'''Inquisitor Lashona:''' ''"In the name of the White Mantle, everyone in this settlement is now under arrest!"''
:'''Captain Greywind:''' ''"We've done nothing to deserve this! We've lived in peace with the Krytans for years!"''
:'''Captain Greywind:''' ''"Have you forgotten so soon? Your own [[Justiciar Hablion]] granted us this land."''
:'''Inquisitor Lashona:''' ''"I think it's you who is forgetting. Your countrymen gained his trust through lies and deceit, and were even welcomed as Knights of the White Mantle..."''
:'''Inquisitor Lashona:''' ''"Only to cut down our dear Hablion in cold blood, and murder the benevolent [[Confessor Dorian]] and his [[Inner Council|high council]]."''
:'''Inquisitor Lashona:''' ''"You [[Ascalon]]ians have brought your own twisted sense of peace to our land, and I assure you that we will hold you accountable for those villainous actions! Peace...hah! What a travesty."''
:'''Inquisitor Lashona:''' ''"Commander, place these filthy refugees under arrest."''
:'''White Mantle Zealot:''' ''"My pleasure."''
:'''White Mantle Zealot:''' ''"Listen up, you Ascalonian trash. Drop your weapons and come with us. Now!"''
:'''<Character name>:''' ''"Your fight is with us; leave these people in peace!"''
:'''Inquisitor Lashona:''' ''"You are all hereby sentenced to death for the crime of high treason. Men, leave no one alive!"''

===Reward dialogue===
;Princess Salma
:''"Thank you <Character name>, your efforts bring us one step closer to a unified nation."''

== Notes ==
* Lashona will not [[spawn]] if [[Evil Residents]] (the [[Halloween]] quest) is active.

{{anomaly|This quest cannot be combined with [[Merchant's Plea]] and only under certain circumstances with [[Defend North Kryta Province]]; [[Captain Greywind]] refuses to talk about shipment.}}

{{bug|This quest was available again for some [[characters]], after completion of the first two quests of the Thackeray's Missions in [[Hearts of the North]] campaign.}}

{{bug|This quest refers to Salma as queen before she becomes queen.}}

{{bug|Players who started the three required [[Wanted by the Shining Blade|''Wanted'' quests]] before the [[Feedback:Game_updates/20101119|19 November 2010 update]] might be forced to take [[The War in Kryta|the official umbrella quest]], which is optional otherwise. If you are unable to move on to [[Riverside Assassination]], speak to [[Murro]] in Lion's Arch and add ''The War in Kryta'' to your quest log.}}
